audio-extractor.function_description: Extracts audio from video files and saves as mono 16kHz WAV.
audio-extractor.when_to_use: When you need audio from a video for speech or energy analysis.
audio-extractor.limitations: Cannot process video formats unsupported by ffmpeg.

audiobook.function_description: Convert fetched article text into a concatenated MP3 audiobook.
audiobook.when_to_use: When you need to turn a web article or text document into an audio book.
audiobook.limitations: Cannot generate audio if required TTS API keys are missing and content is below the minimum length check.

analyze-ci.function_description: Analyzes GitHub Action job logs and returns concise failure summary.
analyze-ci.when_to_use: Use when you need a concise summary of why a GitHub Action job failed.

browser-testing.function_description: Measures load time, network requests, and performance metrics for a given URL using Playwright CDP.
browser-testing.when_to_use: Use when you need to diagnose page load speed or API response times.

ac-branch-pi-model.function_description: Computes per-unit power flows for MATPOWER branch data, handling transformers and line charging.
ac-branch-pi-model.when_to_use: Use when you need branch power flow values for AC optimal power flow analysis.
ac-branch-pi-model.limitations: Assumes MATPOWER format and per‑unit system; cannot handle non‑linear tap models.

13f-analyzer.function_description: Analyzes fund holding summary data to report statistics and changes for specified quarters.
13f-analyzer.when_to_use: When you need a quick summary or change analysis of a hedge fund’s holdings for a specific quarter.

csv-processing.function_description: Processes CSV files to read, filter, compute, and write data using pandas.

automatic-speech-recognition.function_description: Transcribes audio segments to text using Whisper and aligns them with speaker diarization turns.
automatic-speech-recognition.when_to_use: Use after speaker diarization to generate speaker-labeled transcripts or subtitles from audio segments.
automatic-speech-recognition.limitations: Cannot transcribe segments shorter than 0.3 seconds or produce text for inaudible audio.

custom-distance-metrics.function_description: Define custom distance functions for numpy array points used in clustering.
custom-distance-metrics.when_to_use: When you need a tailored similarity measure for clustering algorithms on your data.
custom-distance-metrics.limitations: Custom Python distance functions are slower than built-in metrics and may not scale to large datasets.

cvss-score-extraction.function_description: Extract CVSS v3 score from vulnerability JSON data using source priority.
cvss-score-extraction.when_to_use: Use when creating security reports that require CVSS scores from Trivy scan output.
cvss-score-extraction.limitations: Returns 'N/A' for missing scores and assumes the data follows Trivy's nested CVSS structure.

constraint-parser.function_description: Extract scheduling constraints from raw email text.
constraint-parser.when_to_use: When you have an email requesting a meeting and need its time constraints.

academic-pdf-redaction.function_description: Redacts specified identifying text patterns from PDF documents, preserving the References section.
academic-pdf-redaction.when_to_use: Use when preparing a manuscript for blind peer review to remove author-identifying information.
academic-pdf-redaction.limitations: Cannot redact partial names or content in the References section; requires searchable text.

citation-management.function_description: Generate BibTeX entries from DOIs, PMIDs, or arXiv IDs by extracting metadata.
citation-management.when_to_use: When you need to convert DOIs, PMIDs, or arXiv IDs into properly formatted BibTeX entries.

box-least-squares.function_description: Analyzes light curve arrays to compute a Box Least Squares periodogram and identify transit parameters.
box-least-squares.when_to_use: When you have cleaned light curve data and need to find periodic transit signals.
box-least-squares.limitations: Cannot detect grazing transits well and relies on proper period grid selection.

civ6lib.function_description: Validates Civ6 district placement on map tiles and calculates adjacency bonuses.
civ6lib.when_to_use: When you need to check if a district can be placed or compute its adjacency bonuses.
civ6lib.limitations: Cannot validate placements on water, mountains, or natural wonders and assumes correct tile data.

d3-visualization.function_description: Generate static D3.js visualizations (HTML/SVG) from CSV, TSV, or JSON data files.
d3-visualization.when_to_use: Use when the user requests a chart, graph, or other visualization from CSV/TSV/JSON data.
d3-visualization.limitations: Cannot generate animated or non-deterministic visualizations; only static, deterministic outputs are supported.

data-reconciliation.function_description: Operates on spreadsheet tables to recover missing financial values using sum, YoY, share, and CAGR constraints.
data-reconciliation.when_to_use: Use when a spreadsheet has missing cells but row totals, percentages, or growth rates are known.
data-reconciliation.limitations: Cannot fill values lacking sufficient constraints or when data is inconsistent.

attention-variants-from-papers.function_description: Implement custom transformer attention variant while keeping drop-in module interface.
attention-variants-from-papers.when_to_use: When a paper modifies attention scores, branches, normalization, or head sharing but requires a drop-in transformer block.
attention-variants-from-papers.limitations: Cannot alter input/output shapes or mask semantics; assumes they remain unchanged.

contribution-analysis.function_description: Analyzes a CSV dataset to compute factor contributions using R² decomposition.
contribution-analysis.when_to_use: When you have multiple correlated variables across categories and need to quantify each factor's contribution to response variance.

dc-power-flow.function_description: Computes DC power flow on bus/branch grid data, producing bus angles and line flows.
dc-power-flow.when_to_use: Use when you need a linear approximation of AC power flow for economic dispatch or contingency analysis.
dc-power-flow.limitations: Assumes lossless lines, flat voltage, and small angle approximations; cannot model resistive losses or voltage magnitude variations.

azure-bgp.function_description: Analyzes Azure BGP topology JSON files to detect oscillation and route leaks and suggest policy fixes.
azure-bgp.when_to_use: Use when Azure Virtual WAN BGP shows flapping routes, oscillation, or unexpected route leaks.
azure-bgp.limitations: Cannot modify on-prem routers or disable Azure BGP sessions; only suggests policy-level fixes.

casadi-ipopt-nlp.function_description: Creates and solves a CasADi nonlinear programming model using IPOPT.

dyn-object-masks.function_description: Detect moving objects in video frames and generate sparse binary masks.
dyn-object-masks.when_to_use: Use when you need to detect moving objects in video with camera motion.

elevenlabs-tts.function_description: Converts input text into MP3 speech audio using ElevenLabs API.
elevenlabs-tts.when_to_use: Use when you need to create spoken audio from a short text snippet.
elevenlabs-tts.limitations: Cannot process text longer than ~5000 characters per request.

docx.function_description: Replace placeholders in a .docx template, handling split runs, tables, headers, footers, and conditionals.
docx.when_to_use: When you need to populate a Word template with data while preserving formatting.
docx.limitations: Formatting beyond the first run may be lost; only {{KEY}} placeholders are supported.

discover-important-function.function_description: Python repository files: analyze and rank potential fuzz targets.
discover-important-function.when_to_use: Use when you need to find the best functions to fuzz in a Python package.
discover-important-function.limitations: Cannot modify source code or execute it; only performs static analysis.

dialogue_graph.function_description: Creates and manages dialogue graph structures, exporting to JSON and visualizing as images.
dialogue_graph.when_to_use: Use when converting text to data, editing conversation flow, traversing dialogue trees, or visualizing dialogue flows.
dialogue_graph.limitations: Visualization requires Graphviz binary installed; otherwise it cannot generate images.

ffmpeg.function_description: Extract I-frames from video files using FFmpeg.
ffmpeg.when_to_use: When you need to obtain individual key frames from a video file.
ffmpeg.limitations: Assumes FFmpeg is installed and the input video is supported by FFmpeg.

erlang-distribution.function_description: Erlang nodes – establish cluster connectivity, register global names, and perform distributed messaging and RPC.
erlang-distribution.when_to_use: When you need to build a fault‑tolerant Erlang cluster with remote process calls.
erlang-distribution.limitations: Assumes nodes share the same cookie and reachable network; cannot manage nodes behind firewalls.

enterprise-artifact-search.function_description: Search enterprise artifacts and extract structured entities across linked documents.
enterprise-artifact-search.when_to_use: When a query requires multi‑hop evidence across documents, chats, meetings, or PRs with precise artifact pointers.
enterprise-artifact-search.limitations: It cannot infer information; it only returns data present in grounded artifacts.

erlang-concurrency.function_description: Erlang processes – create, spawn, link, monitor, and pass messages for concurrent execution.
erlang-concurrency.when_to_use: Apply processes for concurrent tasks requiring isolation and independent state.

exoplanet-workflows.function_description: light curve data: guide selection of exoplanet detection workflow steps.
exoplanet-workflows.when_to_use: Use when planning an exoplanet search pipeline on photometric light curves.
exoplanet-workflows.limitations: It only offers guidance; it does not execute detection algorithms or process data.

ffmpeg-audio-processing.function_description: Processes audio tracks in video files using FFmpeg.
ffmpeg-audio-processing.when_to_use: Use when you need to extract, normalize, mix, or convert audio from video files.

ffmpeg-media-info.function_description: Extracts metadata from video or audio files using ffprobe and ffmpeg.
ffmpeg-media-info.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve video or audio file properties such as codec, resolution, or bitrate.

energy-calculator.function_description: Calculates per-second RMS energy from a WAV audio file.
energy-calculator.when_to_use: Use when you need per-second audio energy for silence or pause detection.
energy-calculator.limitations: Only supports WAV audio files as input.

ffmpeg-video-editing.function_description: Processes video files to cut, trim, concatenate, and split segments.
ffmpeg-video-editing.when_to_use: Use when you need to cut, trim, concatenate, or split video segments.
ffmpeg-video-editing.limitations: Cannot concatenate videos with different codecs using copy mode; re-encoding required.

erlang-otp-behaviors.function_description: Erlang source files implement OTP behaviors to create stateful server processes.
erlang-otp-behaviors.when_to_use: Use when building reliable concurrent Erlang applications requiring process patterns.

find-bugs.function_description: Analyze git diff of source code files to identify security bugs and code quality issues.
find-bugs.when_to_use: When you need to audit a branch’s changes for security vulnerabilities before merging.
find-bugs.limitations: Cannot automatically fix issues; it only reports findings based on the provided diff.

file-organizer.function_description: Organizes files in a directory by analyzing structure, finding duplicates, and moving them into a logical hierarchy.
file-organizer.when_to_use: Use when folders are messy, contain duplicates, or lack a logical structure.
file-organizer.limitations: Cannot delete files without user confirmation and assumes access to target directories.

filler-word-processing.function_description: Processes JSON filler-word annotations to create cut segments for removing filler speech.
filler-word-processing.when_to_use: Use when you have filler-word timestamps in JSON and want to cut them from audio or video.
filler-word-processing.limitations: Cannot process non-JSON annotation files and assumes predefined word durations.

economic-dispatch.function_description: Optimizes MATPOWER generator data to compute minimum-cost dispatch with reserves and generator limits.
economic-dispatch.limitations: OSQP may fail on ill-conditioned problems; CLARABEL is recommended for robustness.

first-order-model-fitting.function_description: Fits first-order system model to experimental data to extract gain and time constant parameters.
first-order-model-fitting.when_to_use: When you have step-response data and need to determine system gain and time constant.
first-order-model-fitting.limitations: Assumes known ambient value and constant input; cannot model higher-order dynamics.

egomotion-estimation.function_description: Classifies camera motion (stay, dolly, pan, tilt, roll) for each video frame.
egomotion-estimation.when_to_use: When you need to classify camera motion from video with possible multiple labels per frame.
egomotion-estimation.limitations: Assumes sufficient texture and lighting; may fail on low‑texture or low‑light video.

flood-detection.function_description: Analyzes water level DataFrame to detect flood days and generate summary reports.
flood-detection.when_to_use: When you need to identify days with water levels exceeding flood thresholds.
flood-detection.limitations: Assumes water level and thresholds share the same units; cannot resolve unit mismatches.

finite-horizon-lqr.function_description: Linear system matrices (A, B, Q, R) → compute finite-horizon LQR gain and first control input.
finite-horizon-lqr.when_to_use: Use when you need a control input for model predictive control at each timestep.

fuzzy-match.function_description: Compares strings and finds best matches using fuzzy similarity metrics.
fuzzy-match.when_to_use: Use when joining datasets on non-identical string keys.

fjsp-baseline-repair-with-downtime-and-p.function_description: Adjust a given FJSP baseline schedule to a feasible, lower‑makespan schedule respecting downtime and budget constraints.
fjsp-baseline-repair-with-downtime-and-p.when_to_use: When the provided FJSP baseline is infeasible or has excessive makespan under downtime and policy limits.
fjsp-baseline-repair-with-downtime-and-p.limitations: Cannot handle non‑integer time units and assumes all downtime windows are pre‑sorted.

ffmpeg-format-conversion.function_description: Convert video or audio files between formats and codecs using FFmpeg.
ffmpeg-format-conversion.when_to_use: When you need to change containers, codecs, or copy streams without re‑encoding.

gemini-count-in-video.function_description: Analyzes video files to count pedestrians, cyclists, and vehicles.
gemini-count-in-video.when_to_use: Use when you need to count pedestrians, cyclists, or vehicles in surveillance videos.
gemini-count-in-video.limitations: It cannot process videos larger than 20 MB without using the File API upload.

gamma-phase-associator.function_description: Associates seismic pick DataFrames to earthquake events, estimating locations, times, and magnitudes.
gamma-phase-associator.when_to_use: Use when you have P/S wave picks and station metadata and need to cluster them into earthquake events.
gamma-phase-associator.limitations: Requires picks and stations DataFrames with specific columns; cannot process raw waveform data.

gemini-video-understanding.function_description: Analyzes video files or YouTube URLs to generate summaries, transcripts, timestamps, and scene events.
gemini-video-understanding.when_to_use: Use when you need a summary, transcript, timestamps, or scene detection for a video or YouTube link.
gemini-video-understanding.limitations: Cannot analyze private, unlisted, or age‑restricted YouTube videos and requires videos under model token limits.

glm-basics.function_description: Modify glm3.nml Fortran namelist file parameters using Python.
glm-basics.when_to_use: When you need to change GLM configuration values without manually editing the namelist file.
glm-basics.limitations: Cannot modify non-numeric or complex namelist entries and assumes standard formatting.

glm-calibration.function_description: Adjust GLM namelist parameters and run simulation to minimize temperature RMSE.
glm-calibration.when_to_use: When observed water temperatures differ significantly from GLM outputs.
glm-calibration.limitations: Cannot calibrate without a valid glm3.nml file or the GLM executable installed.

excitation-signal-design.function_description: Designs step excitation signals for a system to collect identification data.
excitation-signal-design.when_to_use: Use when you need to estimate parameters of an unknown system via a step test.
excitation-signal-design.limitations: Assumes the system is first-order and can accept a step input without saturation.

geospatial-routing-data.function_description: Processes JSON routing data, validating coordinates and converting station IDs to internal indices.
geospatial-routing-data.when_to_use: When preparing a routing model or validating a routing report with station coordinates and IDs.
geospatial-routing-data.limitations: Cannot process data missing required fields or using unsupported distance metrics.

ffmpeg-video-filters.function_description: Applies ffmpeg video filters to modify MP4 video files.
ffmpeg-video-filters.when_to_use: Use when you need to resize, crop, watermark, change speed, or add visual effects to a video.

gmail-skill.function_description: Operates on Gmail messages to send emails, search, read, and manage labels or drafts.
gmail-skill.when_to_use: When you need to send, read, or search Gmail messages via command‑line scripts.
gmail-skill.limitations: It cannot access Gmail without prior OAuth authentication and a valid token.

hex-grid-spatial.function_description: Operates on odd‑r hex grid coordinates to compute neighbors, distances, and tiles within a radius.

gtts.function_description: Convert plain text into an MP3 audio file using Google Text-to-Speech.
gtts.when_to_use: When you need to generate spoken audio from a long text document.
gtts.limitations: It requires an internet connection and offers limited voice customization.

hibernate-upgrade.function_description: Java source files: upgrade Hibernate 5 annotations and configurations to Hibernate 6.

fuzzing-python.function_description: Configure and run coverage-guided fuzz testing on Python code using Atheris.
fuzzing-python.when_to_use: When you need to discover bugs by fuzzing a Python project or its native extensions.
fuzzing-python.limitations: Cannot produce grammar-aware inputs for complex formats without a custom mutator.

image_editing.function_description: Processes image files to resize, convert format, and apply various transformations using ImageMagick.
image_editing.when_to_use: When you need to quickly resize or convert multiple images from the command line.
image_editing.limitations: Requires ImageMagick installed; cannot process non-image files.

hierarchical-taxonomy-clustering.function_description: Processes DataFrame category paths to generate a unified hierarchical taxonomy via clustering.
hierarchical-taxonomy-clustering.when_to_use: When you have category paths from multiple sources and need a consolidated taxonomy.
hierarchical-taxonomy-clustering.limitations: Assumes category paths are pre‑cleaned and limited to five hierarchical levels.

jackson-security.function_description: Analyzes JSON input for Jackson deserialization security risks.

geospatial-analysis.function_description: GeoJSON geospatial data: project to metric CRS and calculate point-to-boundary distances.
geospatial-analysis.when_to_use: When you need accurate distances between points and boundaries in GeoJSON data.
geospatial-analysis.limitations: Cannot compute distances correctly without projecting to a metric CRS.

image-ocr.function_description: Extracts text from image files (JPG, PNG, etc.) using OCR.
image-ocr.when_to_use: Use when you need to extract text from scanned documents, screenshots, photos, receipts, or forms.
image-ocr.limitations: Cannot process images larger than 5 MB or with low resolution below 300 DPI.

imc-tuning-rules.function_description: Compute IMC-tuned PI controller gains from process gain and time constant.
imc-tuning-rules.when_to_use: When you need PI controller gains for a first-order process with known gain and time constant.
imc-tuning-rules.limitations: Only works for first-order processes; derivative gain is always zero.

fuzzy-name-search.function_description: Search fund or stock metadata using fuzzy name matching.
fuzzy-name-search.when_to_use: When you need to locate a fund or stock without knowing the exact name or accession number.
fuzzy-name-search.limitations: Requires a quarter argument; cannot search without specifying the quarter.

jakarta-namespace.function_description: Updates Java source files by replacing javax.* imports with jakarta.* equivalents.
jakarta-namespace.when_to_use: When upgrading a Spring Boot project to version 3 and needing to migrate Java EE imports to Jakarta EE.
jakarta-namespace.limitations: Does not modify javax.sql or javax.crypto imports and assumes code uses only listed Java EE packages.

gpt-multimodal.function_description: Analyzes one or multiple images to extract objects, text, colors, and scene descriptions.
gpt-multimodal.when_to_use: Use when you need to understand image content, extract text, or compare visual differences.
gpt-multimodal.limitations: Cannot process animated GIFs or images larger than 20 MB, and requires clear, legible images.

conditioning.function_description: Condition gravitational wave time-series data by high-pass filtering, resampling, cropping, and PSD estimation.
conditioning.when_to_use: Use when raw gravitational-wave detector data contains low-frequency noise and needs preparation for matched filtering.
conditioning.limitations: Cannot process data shorter than required for PSD segments and assumes high-pass filtering precedes resampling.

lab-unit-harmonization.function_description: Standardizes clinical lab dataset values by parsing formats, converting units, and formatting to two decimals.
lab-unit-harmonization.when_to_use: Use when harmonizing lab values from multiple sources with mixed units and inconsistent numeric formats.

light-curve-preprocessing.function_description: Light curve data: clean outliers, filter quality flags, and flatten long-term trends.
light-curve-preprocessing.when_to_use: When you need to prepare raw light curve data for exoplanet period analysis.
light-curve-preprocessing.limitations: Cannot guarantee preservation of transit signals if flattening parameters are too aggressive.

lomb-scargle-periodogram.function_description: light curve object – compute Lomb-Scargle periodogram to identify strongest period.
lomb-scargle-periodogram.when_to_use: Use when you need to detect general periodic signals in unevenly sampled light curves.

locational-marginal-prices.function_description: Extract locational marginal prices (LMPs) from CVXPY power flow model dual values.
locational-marginal-prices.when_to_use: When you need LMPs after solving a CVXPY optimal power flow problem.
locational-marginal-prices.limitations: Requires balance constraints to be stored; returns zero if dual values are unavailable.

lean4-theorem-proving.function_description: Lean .lean files: automatically repair failing proofs and fill sorries using compiler-guided analysis.
lean4-theorem-proving.when_to_use: When you need to fix compilation errors or fill sorries in Lean 4 code.

jax-skills.function_description: Handles JAX arrays: loading from .npy/.npz, applying transformations, and saving results.
jax-skills.when_to_use: Use when performing JAX‑based data loading, transformation, or model prototyping tasks.
jax-skills.limitations: Supports only .npy/.npz files and limited ops (square, mean) for map/reduce.

map-optimization-strategy.function_description: Optimizes item placements on a map grid while respecting placement constraints.
map-optimization-strategy.when_to_use: When you need to place multiple items on a grid and exhaustive search is infeasible.
map-optimization-strategy.limitations: May not find the global optimal placement, only a good local optimum.

integral-action-design.function_description: applies integral action to MPC control signals to eliminate steady-state offset
integral-action-design.when_to_use: use when MPC shows steady-state error from model mismatch

marker.function_description: Converts PDF files to Markdown text while preserving LaTeX formulas and structure.
marker.when_to_use: When you need a Markdown version of a PDF, especially with LaTeX content.
marker.limitations: Cannot process PDFs without the marker_single CLI and does not extract images.

manufacturing-failure-reason-codebook-no.function_description: Assigns standardized codebook codes to failure reason text segments.
manufacturing-failure-reason-codebook-no.when_to_use: Use when engineers' failure reasons need to be normalized and matched to product codebook entries.
manufacturing-failure-reason-codebook-no.limitations: Cannot assign a code if the station does not match the entry's allowed stations.

maven-dependency-management.function_description: pom.xml files: define, scope, version, and manage Maven project dependencies.
maven-dependency-management.when_to_use: when adding, updating, or troubleshooting project libraries in a Maven build.

mhc-algorithm.function_description: Applies doubly stochastic constraints to residual mixing matrices in PyTorch tensors.
mhc-algorithm.when_to_use: Use when training deep networks that suffer stability issues.

meteorology-driver-classification.function_description: Classifies dataset variables into driver categories based on physical meaning.
meteorology-driver-classification.when_to_use: Use this guide when you need to group environmental variables into physical driver categories before analysis.
meteorology-driver-classification.limitations: Cannot classify variables that lack clear physical meaning or belong to multiple categories.

gh-cli.function_description: Operates on GitHub pull requests to create, view, edit, and merge them via the command line.

memory-optimization.function_description: Optimizes Python code to reduce memory consumption while preserving functionality.

lean4-memories.function_description: Operates on Lean 4 proof sessions, storing and retrieving project-specific proof patterns and failures.
lean4-memories.when_to_use: Use when working on multi‑session Lean 4 formalizations that repeat similar proof patterns.
lean4-memories.limitations: Cannot retrieve memories from other projects due to scoped isolation.

mesh-analysis.function_description: Analyzes binary STL files to compute volume and extract material ID of the largest component.
mesh-analysis.when_to_use: Use when you need to analyze geometry, filter noise, or extract material IDs from STL meshes.
mesh-analysis.limitations: Cannot process ASCII STL files; only binary STL is supported.

multimodal-fusion.function_description: Processes video files to enhance speaker diarization by fusing audio with visual cues.
multimodal-fusion.when_to_use: Use when processing video files with multiple visible speakers to improve diarization accuracy using visual cues.
multimodal-fusion.limitations: Cannot process audio-only files and may fail with poor lighting, angles, or high computational cost.

nanogpt-training.function_description: Trains a GPT-2 scale model on tokenized dataset using mixed-precision on a single GPU.
nanogpt-training.when_to_use: Use when training a GPT-2 sized model on a single GPU with tokenized data.

nlp-research-repo-package-installment.function_description: environment.yml or requirements.txt files – set up matching Python environment and install dependencies
nlp-research-repo-package-installment.when_to_use: when reproducing an NLP research repo and need to align the environment with its declared dependencies
nlp-research-repo-package-installment.limitations: cannot proceed if the repository lacks environment.yml or requirements.txt files

nws-flood-thresholds.function_description: Processes NWS flood thresholds CSV to extract numeric flood stage values for specified stations.
nws-flood-thresholds.when_to_use: When you need flood stage thresholds for specific USGS stations from the NWS dataset.
nws-flood-thresholds.limitations: Cannot provide thresholds for stations absent from the NWS CSV or with missing values.

obspy-data-api.function_description: Read seismic waveform files (e.g., SAC, MiniSEED) into an ObsPy Stream object.
obspy-data-api.when_to_use: When you need to import seismogram files for further processing.

maven-build-lifecycle.function_description: Explains Maven pom.xml lifecycle phases and how to run corresponding build commands.
maven-build-lifecycle.when_to_use: When you need to understand or execute Maven build phases for a Java project.
maven-build-lifecycle.limitations: Assumes a standard Maven project structure and does not execute commands itself.

openai-tts.function_description: Convert input text into spoken audio files using OpenAI TTS API.
openai-tts.when_to_use: When you need to generate spoken audio from a short or long text passage.
openai-tts.limitations: Supports up to 4000 characters per request and limited voice options per model.

openai-vision.function_description: Analyzes image files to extract descriptions, objects, text, colors, and compare multiple images.
openai-vision.when_to_use: Use when you need to understand image content, extract text, or compare visual differences.
openai-vision.limitations: It cannot process images larger than 20 MB, animated GIFs, or heavily distorted content.

output-validation.function_description: Validate video, interval JSON, and mask NPZ files for format and consistency.
output-validation.when_to_use: After generating interval instructions and masks, before submission or hand‑off.

matched-filtering.function_description: Applies matched filtering to conditioned detector data using a template waveform to compute SNR and locate peaks.
matched-filtering.when_to_use: Use when you need to detect gravitational-wave signals in conditioned detector data.
matched-filtering.limitations: Requires template and data to share the same sampling rate and PSD length; not all approximants support frequency-domain generation.

parallel-processing.function_description: list of items – parallelize processing across multiple CPU cores
parallel-processing.when_to_use: when you have many independent tasks that each take more than 0.1 seconds
parallel-processing.limitations: cannot speed up very fast tasks and assumes each task runs independently

pause-detector.function_description: Processes an energy JSON file to detect low-energy pause segments.
pause-detector.when_to_use: When you need to identify natural pauses in audio using pre-computed energy data.
pause-detector.limitations: Cannot generate energy data; it only works with existing energy JSON files.

modal-gpu.function_description: Runs a Python function on a cloud GPU and returns its result.
modal-gpu.when_to_use: Use when you need to run a Python training script on a cloud GPU.

object_counter.function_description: Counts objects in an image using a threshold and non‑maximum suppression.

pareto-optimization.function_description: Compute Pareto frontier of a pandas DataFrame based on specified objectives.
pareto-optimization.when_to_use: Use when you need to identify optimal trade‑offs among competing metrics in a dataset.

pcap-triage-tshark.function_description: PCAP file: extract HTTP request fields and follow TCP streams with tshark.
pcap-triage-tshark.when_to_use: When you need to quickly inspect HTTP traffic and payloads in a PCAP.

pcap-analysis.function_description: Analyzes PCAP files to compute network statistics and detect anomalies.
pcap-analysis.when_to_use: When you need to extract traffic metrics and detect anomalies from a PCAP capture.
pcap-analysis.limitations: Assumes PCAP contains IP and transport layers; detection thresholds are fixed.

maven-plugin-configuration.function_description: Configure Maven plugins in a pom.xml file
maven-plugin-configuration.when_to_use: Use when you need to set up or modify Maven plugin settings in a project's pom.xml.
maven-plugin-configuration.limitations: It does not run Maven builds or validate plugin compatibility.

glm-output.function_description: Read GLM NetCDF output, convert heights to depths, and compute RMSE against observed temperatures.
